deviations: Twins: excluded from every table, as from the decision set (data.candidate_table iterates p['candidates'] only; the pilot bank has no twins). Their chains exist in gen_chain_one.jsonl but enter nothing here.

RESULTS_PILOT R8's own counts differ by 1-5 steps for L/P (all wrong outputs; the R8 script is not in the repository); the pilot column here is the s_roll recomputation, run by this script on the pilot generations.

(A) the R8 'dominant error' column was free text; here it is an explicit mutually exclusive error typology (err_type), applied identically to the pilot and confirmation generations. It was written for this replication; it selects nothing and sets no threshold.
